sources.use: Synthetic reproducible tasks with deterministic scoring.

notes: Calibration tasks are excluded from formal hypothesis tests.
Thresholds must be frozen before the test split is run.
NIST-derived text is stored as short paraphrases with source URLs.
Six predeclared test tasks are reused for a cross-source stress analysis.
